decision.observation: Card reward: Iron Wave (1 energy, gain 5 Block + deal 5 damage), True Grit (1, gain 7 Block, exhaust a random card), Body Slam (1, damage equal to Block).

decision.memory: Deck is at 11 cards; Iron Wave adds efficient dual-purpose damage/block.
